# Diff

Compares two objects property by property.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Diff(first, second)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `first` | object | The object before the change. Null is read as an empty object. Any other value that is not an object is a runtime error. |
| `second` | object | The object after the change. Null is read as an empty object. Any other value that is not an object is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Object. A new object with three properties, each an object: `added` holds each property of second whose name first does not have, with its value in second; `removed` holds each property of first whose name second does not have, with its value in first; `changed` holds, for each name both have with values that are not equal, an object with `from`, the value in first, and `to`, the value in second. Values are compared by value, so equal arrays or objects, and two nulls, are not a change. Only the top-level properties are compared. Never null.

## Example

`Diff({"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"b": 3, "c": 4})` returns `{"added": {"c": 4}, "removed": {"a": 1}, "changed": {"b": {"from": 2, "to": 3}}}`.
